visual.general_description: Patient recruitment flowchart for the Autologous Conditioned Plasma case series.
visual.detailed_description: Single-panel flowchart with green main boxes down the left and pink exclusion boxes to the right, giving printed counts of patients and knees at each stage from 165 treated patients to 114 knees in the 12-month follow-up.

panels.general_description: Vertical recruitment flowchart of patients receiving Autologous Conditioned Plasma treatment, with excluded groups in side boxes and knees included in the 12 month follow-up at the bottom.
panels.detailed_description: Flowchart of rectangular boxes joined by a single vertical line running down the left-centre. Pale green-gray main boxes read, from top to bottom: "Patients receiving Autologous Conditioned Plasma treatment during study period n = 165"; "Eligible patients n = 159"; "Patients included in analysis (n = 140)" with sub-items "patients with one-sided treatment, 123" and "patients with bilateral treatment, 18" followed by "Knees included in analysis (n = 158)"; and a light green box "Knees included in the 12-month follow-up n = 114". Pink-beige side boxes to the right give exclusions: "Excluded patients (n = 6)" with items "did not receive a third injection, 4", "did not have an e-mail address, 1" and "did not understand Dutch language, 1"; "Did not give broad consent n = 19"; and "Excluded knees (n = 44)" with "received alternative treatment within 1 year, 6" (sub-items "knee joint distraction, 3", "ligament surgery, 1", "total knee arthroplasty, 2"), "wished to leave study, 13" and "did not fill in 12 months survey for unknown reason, 25". No arrowheads are visible on the connecting line.
pixel_observations: Printed counts in the main boxes: 165, 159, 140 (123 one-sided and 18 bilateral), 158 knees and 114 knees.
Printed counts in the exclusion boxes: 6 excluded patients (4, 1 and 1), 19 without broad consent, and 44 excluded knees (6, 13 and 25; the 6 split as 3, 1 and 2).
The printed one-sided (123) and bilateral (18) patient counts add to 141, while the box above them prints 140 patients.

clinical_significance.statement: Per the article text, 140 patients (158 knees) could be included in the series.

panels.general_description: Line plot of mean KOOS subscale scores (symptoms, pain, sport and recreation, knee-related quality of life, activities of daily living) at baseline, 3, 6 and 12 months.
panels.detailed_description: Single plot on a pale yellow textured background with a black axis frame. The y axis is titled KOOS (mean) with printed ticks 0, 20, 40, 60, 80 and 100; the x axis labels are Baseline, 3 months, 6 months and 12 months. A boxed legend in the upper part of the plot lists five series: Symptoms (magenta circle), Pain (orange square), Sport and recreation (dark olive upward triangle), Knee-related quality-of-life (green downward triangle) and Activities of daily living (blue diamond). Each series is a line of four markers. The Symptoms and Activities of daily living series lie almost on top of each other, form the highest pair of series and rise from baseline to 3 months with little change afterwards; the Pain series lies below them and rises from baseline to 3 months with little change afterwards; the Knee-related quality-of-life series is the second lowest and the Sport and recreation series is the lowest, with the latter rising to 6 months and falling at 12 months. No data labels are printed. The right part of the image canvas is empty.
